parameters.query:
-- Business, products, offers and recent prompts for one day's playlist.
SELECT post.plan_context(($1::jsonb ->> 'business_id')::uuid, ($1::jsonb ->> 'date')::date) AS ctx;

-- Business, products and recent captions for one design.
SELECT post.design_context(($1::jsonb ->> 'business_id')::uuid) AS ctx;

-- Saves the picture + captions: the playlist item becomes ready (or a new post made by hand).
SELECT post.finish_design($1::jsonb) AS result;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ post_id: $('Config').first().json.postId || null, business_id: $('Config').first().json.businessId, format: $('Config').first().json.format, storage_path: $('Image to file').first().json.storage_path, bytes: $('Image to file').first().json.bytes, alt_text: $('Build image request').first().json.altText, caption: $('Build image request').first().json.caption, variants: $('Build image request').first().json.variants, brief: $('Build image request').first().json.brief, publish: $('Config').first().json.publish, scheduled_at: $('Config').first().json.scheduledAt || null, image_cost: $('Build image request').first().json.endpoint === 'edits' ? $('Config').first().json.costs.imageEdit : $('Config').first().json.costs.image, text_cost: $('Config').first().json.costs.text }) }}

Press Redo to try again.').slice(0, 280) }) }}

parameters.content:
## Retexia — Post (plan + design)
One webhook for post.retexia.com, header **X-Retexia-Key** (Config → `retexiaKey` = N8N_POST_KEY).

**plan** `{action:'plan', business_id, date, slots:[{key, format, time, hint}], caption_language, design_language, prompt_language}` → one text call → answers `{items:[{key, title, prompt, angle, product}]}`.

**design** `{action:'design', business_id, post_id?, prompt, format:'post'|'story', caption_language, design_language, publish, scheduled_at?}` → answers at once → captions + picture (4:5 or 9:16) → Storage → `post.finish_design()`. Errors → `post.design_failed()`.

Languages: captions si / si_en / singlish / en / ta; picture text si / en / ta.
Publishing is done by post.retexia.com with each customer's own Facebook/Instagram access.

Activate, then copy the Production URL of the webhook into **N8N_POST_URL**.
